name: Simeon
title: Jacob's second son and ancestor of the tribe of Simeon
summary: Simeon was the second son of Jacob and Leah, and one of the twelve patriarchs of Israel. He is particularly known for his violent revenge against the city of Shechem together with his brother Levi, after their sister Dinah was dishonored. His tribe was later absorbed into the territory of the tribe of Judah, in accordance with Jacob's prophetic blessing that predicted dispersion within Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Simeon was born as the second son to Jacob and Leah. Leah named him Simeon, saying, 'Because the Lord heard that I am unloved, he has given me this son also.'

keyEvents.title: The Revenge on Shechem
keyEvents.description: After Shechem, the son of Hamor, had dishonored their sister Dinah, Simeon and Levi carried out a bloody act of revenge. They killed all the men in the city while they were weak from circumcision, which aroused strong displeasure in Jacob.

keyEvents.title: Simeon Held as Hostage in Egypt
keyEvents.description: When Jacob's sons came to Egypt to buy grain, Joseph demanded that they bring Benjamin back with them. Joseph kept Simeon behind as a hostage until his brothers returned with Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Simeon's Release
keyEvents.description: When the brothers returned to Egypt with Benjamin, Simeon was released and reunited with his brothers.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Prophetic Words over Simeon
keyEvents.description: On his deathbed, Jacob spoke prophetic words over his sons. Simeon and Levi were mentioned together and received a warning that their violent temper would lead to them being scattered in Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Simeon in the Promised Land
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Simeon received its inheritance within the territory of the tribe of Judah, in accordance with Jacob's prophecy about scattering. The tribe was gradually absorbed into Judah.
